messages.subject: Help needed with intepretation
parts:
Hi All,

I am very new to Lavaan, R and statistics generally.

I successfully used Lavaan to run a SEM analysis on my data, that's where the romance ends. Interpreting the data has been a challenge. I will be grateful if i can get some direction.

OGAR

=====================================================
Questions
=====================================================
.To what extent does System quality affect user satisfaction and benefits in e-Learning systems?
• To what extent does system quality affect user satisfaction in e-Learning systems?
• To what extent does information quality affect user satisfaction in e-Learning systems? 
• To what extent does instructional quality affect user satisfaction in e-Learning systems?
• To what extent does user satisfaction affect the benefits of the e-Learning system?
======================================================================
variables
===========================================================
SYQ : System Quality
IFQ : Information Quality
ISQ: Instructional Quality
USR: User Satisfaction
BEN: Benefits


=========================================
Lavaan Code
==========================================
CMS<-'
#Latent variables

SYQ=~syq1+syq2+syq3
IFQ=~ifq1+ifq2+ifq3
ISQ=~isq1+isq2+isq3
USR=~us1+us2+us3
BEN=~be1+be2+be3

#Regression Model
USR~SYQ+IFQ+ISQ
BEN~USR
'

Pdata<-read.csv("SEM_Data_Thesis.csv")
 Pfit<-cfa(CMS,data=Pdata)
 summary(Pfit, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
 lavaan.diagram(Pfit, title = "Perception Model Diagram")

semPaths(Pfit, intercepts = FALSE)

semPaths(Pfit, intercepts = FALSE, TITLE = "SEM Diagram", "std")
